# ----- RSYNC (FNAL -> local): pull the L1/L2/L4 gauge configs for local analysis -------------------
# FNAL host : lq.fnal.gov   (login node; needs your FNAL ssh/kerberos auth. ~/affine -> /lustre2/affine symlink)
# FNAL base : /lustre2/affine/redo/     (each ensemble = <col-1 basename>/ under here; covers L1/L2 + L4)
# Pull ONLY ckpoint_lat.* -- the gauge configs (ckpoint_lat.<k>, ~0.64 MB each). Do NOT pull ckpoint_rng.*
# (thinned KRNG, ~0.5 GB each, not needed for measurement), logs, binaries (*.o), or slurm_*.out.
# From the LOCAL machine (repeatable; rsync sends only new k's) -- all redo L1/L2/L4 ensembles at once:
#   rsync -avz --prune-empty-dirs \
#     --include='Nf*_*nt128L*_hb*/' --include='ckpoint_lat.*' --exclude='*' \
#     nmatsum@lq.fnal.gov:/lustre2/affine/redo/ <LOCAL_DEST>/
# (or per-ensemble: rsync -avz nmatsum@lq.fnal.gov:'/lustre2/affine/redo/<basename>/ckpoint_lat.*' <LOCAL_DEST>/<basename>/)
